one_line_answer.text: Hazard symbols show the class of a dangerous material. PPE symbols show what PPE must be worn.

cites.quote: Hazard Classified Symbol
Class A Compressed Gas Classifying material
PPE Symbol
indicate what Personal Protective Equipment (P.P.E) must be worn

bangla_explanation: Symbol দেখে বোঝা যায় কোন material বিপজ্জনক আর কোন PPE পরতে হবে।
Hazard symbol-এর ছয়টি Class: A compressed gas, B flammable, C oxidizing, D toxic, E corrosive, F reactive।
PPE symbol বলে কী পরতে হবে, যেমন apron, goggles, face shield, gloves।
কোনো symbol না চিনলে Safety Office-এ জিজ্ঞেস করুন।

example.en: A chemistry lab bottle shows a flame symbol and a goggles symbol. The trainee wears goggles and keeps fire away.
example.bn: ল্যাবের বোতলে আগুনের চিহ্ন (Class B) আর goggles-এর চিহ্ন: goggles পরুন, আগুন দূরে রাখুন।

list_answer.title: Classes of hazard symbols

items.text: Class A Compressed Gas: a gas packaged under pressure in a cylinder.

cites.quote: Class A Compressed Gas Classifying material which is a gas
packaged under pressure in
a cylinder or other container

items.text: Class B Flammable and Combustible Materials: will ignite and continue to burn.

cites.quote: Class B Flammable and Combustible Materials Classifying
material that will ignite and continue to burn in air

items.text: Class C Oxidizing Materials: release oxygen and add to the combustion of flammable materials.

cites.quote: Class C Oxidizing Materials This symbol identifies material
that releases oxygen or other oxidizing substances
contributing to the combustion of other flammable materials

items.text: Class D toxic and infectious materials: the greatest potential hazard to life and health.

cites.quote: Class D These symbols represent the class of materials that
pose the greatest potential hazard to our life and health.
Toxic Effects The skull and cross bones identifies acutely toxic
Division 3: Biohazardous Infectious Material

items.text: Class E Corrosive Material: attacks metals and damages human tissues.

cites.quote: Class E Corrosive Material Corrosive material can attack metals
can cause permanent damage to human
tissues and organs

items.text: Class F Dangerously Reactive Material: may react violently, even with water.

cites.quote: Class F Dangerously Reactive Material
These materials may react
violently under certain conditions or react violently with water

items_bn: Class A, Compressed Gas — চাপ দিয়ে cylinder-এ ভরা গ্যাস; চাপের কারণেই বিপজ্জনক।
Class B, Flammable ও Combustible — সহজে আগুন ধরে আর জ্বলতেই থাকে।
Class C, Oxidizing — oxygen ছাড়ে, ফলে দাহ্য জিনিসের আগুন আরও বাড়িয়ে দেয়।
Class D, Toxic ও Infectious — জীবন ও স্বাস্থ্যের জন্য সবচেয়ে বড় সম্ভাব্য বিপদ।
Class E, Corrosive — ধাতু ক্ষয় করে আর মানুষের শরীরের কোষ-কলা নষ্ট করে।
Class F, Dangerously Reactive — হঠাৎ প্রচণ্ড বিক্রিয়া করতে পারে, এমনকি পানির সাথেও।

short.prompt: Write down the meaning of the PPE symbols.
short.modelAnswer:
1. Apron: an apron resistant to the hazardous material must be worn.
2. Goggles: chemical-resistant, splash-proof goggles must be worn.
3. Face Shield: must be worn, with safety glasses or goggles too.
4. Hand Protection: gloves suitable for the hazard must be worn.
